{"consolidated_memory":"## Wrong environment in config loader - Two distinct incidents

**Component:** platform/config/loader.py (platform side)
**Problem:** wrong environment in the config loader
**Reproduction:** boot the service with an unset profile variable
**Signal:** a production endpoint appears in a staging process
**Test coverage:** tests/platform/test_config_loader.py (Python stack)

### Occasion 1: [2026-08-02]
**Manifestation:** Error appeared only for tenants with more than ten thousand distinct keys
**Root cause:** mutable default argument shared across calls
**Fix:** made the default empty and built the value per call (PR #6229, branch fix/wrong-environment-7)
**Result:** error rate dropped from 5.3 percent to under 1 per ten thousand

### Occasion 2: [2026-08-08]
**Manifestation:** Flaky failures appeared only on the first request after a cold start
**Root cause:** missing composite index on (tenant_id, created_at)
**Fix:** added the composite index and backfilled in batches (PR #9100, branch fix/wrong-environment-8)
**Result:** the flaky test went from 31 failures per hundred runs to zero

Note: Both occasions produced the same symptom but had distinct root causes and required separate fixes applied 6 days apart."}
